description: Encode text to Unicode scalar values in decimal, hex, binary or octal, or decode those codes back to text, the same way as the ASCII converter page. Optional prefixes (0x, U+, 0b, 0o, HTML entities). ASCII is 0–127; values above that are included unless ascii_only is true. Or return the official Unicode names and traditional abbreviations for 0–127. Input is not stored.

prefix.description: For encode, how to write each value

separator.description: For encode, how to join values, default space

text.description: Text to encode, or codes to decode

name: ascii_converter
title: Convert text to and from decimal, hex, binary or octal codes
